name: Exsim Hospitality Berhad
overview: 2026年，Exsim Hospitality Berhad 通过拟收购 Empire City 一栋在建酒店大楼（456间客房，代价2.26亿令吉）扩大酒店资产组合，并提议将业务多元化至一般承包和集中采购业务。公司全年营收从1.465亿令吉增至2.812亿令吉，净利润从1800万令吉增至4070万令吉。
overview_en: In 2026, Exsim Hospitality Berhad expanded its hotel portfolio through the proposed acquisition of a purpose-built hotel tower in Empire City (456 rooms, RM226.0 million consideration) and proposed diversifying into general contracting and centralised procurement businesses. Full-year revenue rose from RM146.5 million to RM281.2 million, while net profit increased from RM18.0 million to RM40.7 million.

segments.name: 自有及运营
segments.note: 今年拟收购 Empire City 一栋在建酒店大楼，以扩大自有酒店资产。
segments.note_en: This year, proposed to acquire a purpose-built hotel tower under construction in Empire City to expand owned hotel assets.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 拟以2.26亿令吉现金收购 Empire City 一栋32层、456间客房的四星级酒店大楼（Tower F Building）。
actions.text_en: Proposed to acquire a 32-storey, 456-room 4-star hotel tower (Tower F Building) in Empire City for RM226.0 million cash.

segments.name: 装修工程
segments.note: 今年提议将业务多元化至一般承包业务和集中采购业务。
segments.note_en: This year, proposed to diversify into general contracting and centralised procurement businesses.

actions.text: 提议将业务多元化至一般承包业务（General Contracting Business）。
actions.text_en: Proposed diversification into general contracting business.

actions.text: 提议将业务多元化至建筑材料和家用电器集中采购业务（Centralised Procurement Business）。
actions.text_en: Proposed diversification into centralised procurement of building materials and household appliances.

model_changes.title: CIRCULAR TO SHAREHOLDERS IN RELATION TO THE:- PART A I. PROPOSED DIVERSIFICATION OF THE EXISTING BUSINESS OF EXSIM HOSPITALITY BERHAD ("EHB"
model_changes.text: 提议将业务多元化至一般承包业务和集中采购业务，新增两条业务线。
model_changes.text_en: Proposed diversification into general contracting and centralised procurement businesses, adding two new business lines.
